text: At its meeting held July 14, 15 and 16, 2021, City Council appointed the following members to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board for a term of office from July 17, 2021 to July 15, 2025, and until successors are appointed: - Stuart Galloway - Kimberly Marshall - Jean Olemou These new appointments fill the positions previously held by Karim Bardeesy and Jacoline Loewen whose terms of office came to an end on July 16, 2021. In addition, Kimberly Marshall was reappointed following her last term which ended on July 16, 2021.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
